entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Genuin's software development kit, distributed as a compiled native library for Android/iOS and as a JavaScript library for web, that publishers integrate to request video content from Genuin servers and render the Genuin Player.

entities.name: Genuin Player
entities.description: The video player rendered via the Genuin SDK that plays content video returned by Genuin servers in publisher placements.

entities.name: Google IMA SDK
entities.description: Google's Interactive Media Ads SDK, integrated inside the Genuin SDK, used to request, render, and fire trackers for audio/video advertisements.

entities.name: Triton
entities.description: Third-party audio ad server (cmod-na.live.streamtheworld.com) that returns VAST audio ad responses to the IMA SDK when the Genuin SDK requests an ad.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Publisher partner whose web property (iheart.com) and station/podcast profiles host Genuin placements such as Highlights and Article Pages.

entities.name: ODSPY
entities.description: Ad serving system named in the VAST response adsystem field, delivering audio ad creatives and tracking endpoints via Triton.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: IAB Video Ad Serving Template standard (version 4.3) used to structure ad responses, linear creatives, companion resources, and tracking events.

entities.name: IAB
entities.description: Industry standards body that defines the VAST specification and IAB content category taxonomy referenced in ad responses.

entities.name: Highlights
entities.description: iHeart Highlights tab on station and podcast profiles where the Genuin SDK widget loads short video clips and streams Stream_Start/Track_Start analytics events.

entities.name: Article Pages
entities.description: iHeart article page placements where the Genuin SDK widget renders alongside editorial content.

entities.name: Genuin BCC
entities.description: Genuin Brand Content Configuration tool where brands configure video category and topic metadata that is then attached to clips as video_category_topic.

entities.name: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
entities.description: An iHeart-owned community on the Genuin platform (brand_id 1729, community handle elvisdurancooler1785) whose Latest Clips loop is served through Genuin placements.

relationships.description: Genuin SDK embeds Google IMA SDK to issue ad requests and execute ad trackers for audio and video advertisements.
The Genuin Player is rendered via the Genuin SDK as the playback surface for content video.
iHeart integrates the Genuin SDK into its web property to render Highlights and Article Pages video placements.
The Genuin SDK, via IMA, calls Triton's streamtheworld endpoint to request audio ads with parameters like stid, episode-url, and type=midroll.
The IMA SDK inside Genuin SDK fires VAST impression and quartile trackers to Triton-hosted od-spy URLs.
Triton serves audio ad responses formatted per the IAB VAST 4.3 specification.
ODSPY is identified as the adsystem inside VAST responses and provides linear creative plus companion resources in VAST format.
ODSPY's ad creatives and tracking endpoints (od-spy.live.streamtheworld.com) are delivered through Triton's streaming infrastructure.
VAST is an IAB-published advertising standard whose 4.3 version and content category taxonomy are referenced in ad payloads.
The Highlights tab is a feature of iHeart station and podcast profiles.
Article Pages are sections of the iHeart web property where Genuin placements appear.
The Highlights placement is powered by the Genuin SDK widget, emitting Placement Initialized, Video Inview, and quartile analytics events.
Article Pages embed the Genuin SDK widget to deliver video clips alongside editorial content.
Genuin BCC is the brand-side configuration tool whose category/topic settings flow through the Genuin SDK as video metadata attributes.

relationships.source: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
relationships.description: The Elvis Duran and the Morning Show community on Genuin is owned by iHeart (brand_id 1729) and surfaced through iHeart placements.

relationships.source: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
relationships.description: Clips from the Elvis Duran and the Morning Show community are returned in the Step 2 video response payload and played by the Genuin SDK.
